setup.text: Toby counts the last tray twice. "Twelve down from forty, near enough."

option_a.text: The player lays a length of wool over the last rising batch to keep the heat in overnight. Toby checks the cover and nods once. "Good."

option_b.text: Toby reads the number, crosses the last mark himself. "Twelve down from forty, near enough."

option_c.text:
"I'll check back after."

Toby nods flatly and keeps folding.
